event_cards.counts: spot bull/bear positions only (paper + real); the rows endpoint also lists perp legs

scope.balance_covers: balance_usdc is the on-chain/ledger USDC available to this account; paper_balance_usdc is the simulated balance used when simulation_mode is true
scope.counters_cover: on-chain WTA prediction-market bets placed from this user's swarm wallet: total_predictions, win_count, loss_count, win_rate, biggest_win, biggest_loss, total_volume, positions_value; total_pnl additionally includes closed clone-bot trades
counters_do_not_cover: event-card bull/bear positions (see the event_cards block here and GET /api/v1/event-cards/positions)
order-book fills (GET /api/v1/trades, which carries its own scope block)
